name: Havengul
description: The largest and most industrialized port city in Nephalia, at the mouth of the Silburlind River.

timeline.summary: The Church of Avacyn establishes the Elgaud Grounds to train cathars, who are sent out as Arms of Avacyn.
timeline.quote: A contingent of the Avacyn Church long ago established a small fort here known as the Elgaud Grounds

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bodysnatchers in Havengul sell disinterred corpses to ghoulcallers and skaberen through the Erdwal.
timeline.quote: Havengul, having the largest human population, is rife with bodysnatchers who disinter corpses

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Erdwal originated as defensive trenches and grew into a trade network and black market.
timeline.quote: originated as trenches created by Nephalians in each of the major cities of Havengul, Drunau, and Selhoff for resisting zombie and werewolf attacks.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The Goldnight find Havengul ablaze with devils.
timeline.quote: They found the town of Havengul ablaze.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The angel Freydalia blesses a small church as a sanctuary for the injured.
timeline.quote: An angel, Freydalia, blessed a small church, casting a spell of protection over it

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Arlinn prays to Avacyn and pulls a boy from under a collapsing carriage with divine strength.
timeline.quote: As the boy's hand touched hers, Arlinn yanked him out from under the carriage with a divine might that sent them both rolling across the ground just as the carriage collapsed.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Devils swarm Olaylie, cutting her and making her bleed.
timeline.quote: Olaylie was lurching through the sky with a devil on her back.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Arlinn hands the rescued boy to Rembert and races back to fight the devils attacking Olaylie.
timeline.quote: Archmage Arlinn Kord thrust the small child into Rembert's outstretched arms.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Devils yank on Olaylie's wings, bringing her crashing to the ground.
timeline.quote: In unison, they heaved back, yanking on the angel's wings, sending Olaylie plummeting to the ground.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Devils pin Arlinn as she prays to Avacyn and receives no answer.
timeline.quote: She waited, opening herself to the power of the protector; she needed power to save the angel.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Olaylie's agonized cry makes Arlinn lose herself and transform into a werewolf.
timeline.quote: Arlinn felt the power of the pain in Olaylie's cry, and just like the night, she came apart.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The werewolf tears into the devils.
timeline.quote: The werewolf surged at the devils.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The werewolf pulls Olaylie down and attacks her.
timeline.quote: The werewolf pulled the angel back to the ground and laid into its flesh with teeth.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The werewolf kills the cathars who try to stop her, one by one.
timeline.quote: One after another. They all fell at the werewolf's mercy.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The werewolf tears the wings off Olaylie and kills her.
timeline.quote: Tore it full off the angel's body.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Rembert recognizes Arlinn, and she sees the bodies of Leighton, Reeves and the other cathars.
timeline.quote: Fallen cathars. Too many of them.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: The werewolf slashes Rembert's cheek, leaving his scars, as he prepares to strike her down.
timeline.quote: her claws digging trenches into his cheek

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: As Rembert's sword falls, Arlinn planeswalks away to another world.
timeline.quote: she had planeswalked that day, so long ago, when her mind had cleaved.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Geor advises following a gryff when lost in a storm.
timeline.quote: If you're lost in a storm, follow a gryff. They always know which way calmer waters lie.

citation.text: Galedrifter (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Olivia leaves for Thunder Junction and Edgar hides in Havengul awaiting his chance.
timeline.quote: awaiting his next chance to return to power

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Recovering power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Geralf replies, telling her to leave him alone as he researches corpses in the estuary that defy stitching.
timeline.quote: Corpses have been washing up in the estuary of late which defy all attempts at stitching.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf warns Gisa not to touch the oil and reveals the invaders are Phyrexians, which Ludevic learned of after a fight with a strange white-haired visitor.
timeline.quote: DO NOT LET THE OIL TOUCH YOU!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf explains the Phyrexians seek to turn Innistrad into an outpost of their empire, and that their oil cannot infect risen dead.
timeline.quote: They wish to transform our glorious home into one more outpost along their long road to empire.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf sends his grotesque creations, including exploding winged turtles, to meet the Phyrexians between the river and the city.
timeline.quote: A wave of terrible creations swarmed over the walls of Havengul to meet the Phyrexians between the river and the city.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf stitches skaabs at frantic speed in his hidden laboratory as Havengul falls, and his skaabs bring in a massive beast.
timeline.quote: a group of the skaabs he'd set to gathering raw materials entered, half-carrying and half-dragging a massive beast.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf's antlered behemoth steps over the city wall and tramples Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: A towering beast stepped over the Havengul wall

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians hack off the legs of Geralf's behemoth and then Gisa's sea-beast; both fall and Gisa stops laughing.
timeline.quote: Like the behemoth before it, it fell

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf stitches the behemoth and sea-beast together in a city square, believing it will be his masterpiece.
timeline.quote: Grabbing the drill he would need to create seams through the beast's chitinous armor, he grinned to himself and set to work.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The fusion of behemoth and sea-beast rises and, with Gisa's ghouls, destroys the remaining attacking Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: watching the last of the attacking forces as they fell, screaming, before the tide of the dead.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The siblings burn dead Phyrexians in a bonfire and bicker over who won the game; Geralf notes the fused beast has collapsed.
timeline.quote: "Neither of us won," Gisa snapped.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa joins Geralf's laboratory in Havengul, and he forces her out; Ludevic and Sorin Markov warn him of the Phyrexian threat.
timeline.quote: They warned him about the impending Phyrexian threat.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gisa joins Geralf's lab in Havengul, is forced out, and takes over the Engelturm.
timeline.quote: She took over the Engelturm left behind by the angels.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion the Cecani siblings lead the region's defense; many citizens are killed.
timeline.quote: the Cecani siblings led the defense of the region

citation.text: "Havengul", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ludevic builds Olag as his final creation, but Olag is kind, so he locks them away.
timeline.quote: Olag remains locked away beneath the laboratory until Ludevic figures out how to fix them.

citation.text: "Ludevic", section "Olag". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin Markov warns Ludevic of the Phyrexian invasion.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov visited Ludevic to inform him about the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Ludevic", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ludevic entrusts Geralf with the defense of Havengul and visits a former student in Selhoff.
timeline.quote: entrusted him with the defense of Havengul

citation.text: "Ludevic", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: I am not regretting the choice to tell you my lab was too small for the both of us

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

relations.quote: The Lord Mayor of Havengul is Herzag

citation.text: "Havengul", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: The largest of Nephalia's three port towns, at the mouth of the Silburlind River.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Nephalia and the Undead

pages_say.description: A city with streets roamed by a gloom surgeon.

citation.text: Avacyn Restored: card flavor text (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A town set ablaze by devils and defended by the Goldnight.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

pages_say.description: A place home to a fisher named Geor.

citation.work: Innistrad: Midnight Hunt: card flavor text
citation.text: Innistrad: Midnight Hunt: card flavor text (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A city whose mayor was pushed off a roof by Rav's possessed geist attacks.

citation.text: "The Edge of the World" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2021.

pages_say.description: A town home to shopkeeper Yaster.

citation.work: Innistrad: Crimson Vow: card flavor text
citation.text: Innistrad: Crimson Vow: card flavor text (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: The sterile, industrial city where Geralf works and which the Phyrexians attack.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

citation.text: "Edgar Markov". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
